prose: Launch HN for Magnitude (YC S25): a self-optimizing inference engine for agents that tunes itself to run as fast as possible on whatever hardware it has, across Mac, Linux and Windows. Only the founders' intro was retrievable this pass, so benchmark numbers are unavailable.
